description: Fisher exact test and per-clade entropy for the human ACCS Arg351 column across 307 vertebrate orthologs
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
P=pd.read_csv('/agent/jobs/a9523a43-994d-4a5f-9d14-987fcc00fedb/provenance/accs_position_survey.csv')
Pc=P[P.R351_sc>=45].copy()
Pc['mammal']=(Pc.clade=='Mammalia')
a=((Pc.mammal)&(Pc.R351=='R')).sum(); b=((Pc.mammal)&(Pc.R351!='R')).sum()
c=((~Pc.mammal)&(Pc.R351=='R')).sum(); d=((~Pc.mammal)&(Pc.R351!='R')).sum()
OR,p=stats.fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]])
print(f'Arg at the hACCS R351 column: mammals {a}/{a+b} ({100*a/(a+b):.1f}%), non-mammals {c}/{c+d} ({100*c/(c+d):.1f}%)')
print(f'Fisher exact 2x2 [[{a},{b}],[{c},{d}]]  odds ratio={OR}  p={p:.3e}')
ci=stats.contingency.odds_ratio([[a,b],[c,d]]).confidence_interval(0.95)
print(f'conditional OR 95% CI: {ci.low:.1f} to {ci.high if np.isfinite(ci.high) else float("inf")}')
# control: K323
K=P[P.K323_sc>=45]
ka=((K.clade=='Mammalia')&(K.K323=='K')).sum(); kb=((K.clade=='Mammalia')&(K.K323!='K')).sum()
kc=((K.clade!='Mammalia')&(K.K323=='K')).sum(); kd=((K.clade!='Mammalia')&(K.K323!='K')).sum()
print(f'\ncontrol K323: mammals {ka}/{ka+kb}, non-mammals {kc}/{kc+kd}, Fisher p={stats.fisher_exact([[ka,kb],[kc,kd]])[1]:.3f}')
# teleost variability: Shannon entropy at R351 col vs K323 col within Actinopterygii
def H(s):
    v=pd.Series(s).value_counts(normalize=True); return float(-(v*np.log2(v)).sum())
act=Pc[Pc.clade=='Actinopterygii']
print(f'\nActinopterygii (n={len(act)}) residues at R351 col: {dict(act.R351.value_counts())}')
print(f'  Shannon entropy = {H(act.R351):.2f} bits (max {np.log2(act.R351.nunique()):.2f} for {act.R351.nunique()} states)')
print(f'  most common state frequency = {act.R351.value_counts(normalize=True).iloc[0]*100:.1f}%  -> not a fixed teleost state')
sau=Pc[Pc.clade=='Sauropsida']; print(f'Sauropsida (n={len(sau)}) entropy at R351 col = {H(sau.R351):.2f} bits (Tyr {100*(sau.R351=="Y").mean():.1f}%)')
mam=Pc[Pc.clade=='Mammalia']; print(f'Mammalia  (n={len(mam)}) entropy at R351 col = {H(mam.R351):.2f} bits')

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.2,4.6))
grp=['Mammalia','Sauropsida','Amphibia','Actinopterygii','Chondrichthyes','Cyclostomata']
grp=[g for g in grp if g in set(Pc.clade)]
ent=[H(Pc[Pc.clade==g].R351) for g in grp]
arg=[100*(Pc[Pc.clade==g].R351=='R').mean() for g in grp]
n=[(Pc.clade==g).sum() for g in grp]
x=np.arange(len(grp))
ax.bar(x-0.2,arg,0.4,label='% Arg at the hACCS Arg351 column',color='#2b6cb0')
ax2=ax.twinx(); ax2.bar(x+0.2,ent,0.4,label='Shannon entropy (bits)',color='#dd6b20')
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([f'{g}\nn={nn}' for g,nn in zip(grp,n)],fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel('% species with Arg',color='#2b6cb0'); ax2.set_ylabel('Shannon entropy (bits)',color='#dd6b20')
ax.set_ylim(0,110); ax2.set_ylim(0,3.2)
ax.set_title('Arg351 is fixed in mammals and absent elsewhere;\nthe ray-finned fish column is variable, not a fixed teleost state',fontsize=11)
h1,l1=ax.get_legend_handles_labels(); h2,l2=ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax.legend(h1+h2,l1+l2,fontsize=8,loc='upper center',frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
